intent: rakazo login issues a scoped, revocable CLI token via browser Allow/Deny approval, replacing token pasting
flow: CLI listener + authorize URL → GET /cli/authorize (session-authed page) → user approves → server stores CliToken hash and delivers raw token once to the CLI loopback callback (or displays it in headless fallback) → CLI stores at 0600 → token authenticates via the actor-resolution choke point in app.ts → revocable from settings (rpc.cliTokens)
scope_rationale: one DB table, one auth choke point, one page + two RPCs, settings panel, CLI login rework; chat/steer/attach unchanged; no mobile/desktop changes

conventions.rule: CLI tokens resolve to the standard Actor only inside apps/api/src/app.ts actor resolution; routes never branch on credential kind
conventions.plan_application: T1 extends the existing bearer resolution; no handler edits

conventions.rule: raw tokens exist only at issuance; storage is SHA-256 hash in a revocable-grant row (CodingSecretGrant shape)
conventions.plan_application: T1 migration copies expiresAt/revokedAt semantics minus default expiry

conventions.rule: server HTML pages are self-contained mount* functions with window.close callback pages
token delivery targets only 127.0.0.1/::1 with a one-time state nonce
conventions.plan_application: T2/T4 share the LOOPBACK_HOSTS rule; CLI owns the listener

conventions.rule: settings lists mirror ModelSettingsOverlay list+revoke; monochrome tokens, no new colors

steps.reason: Design resolved in grill (better-auth plugin evaluated and rejected; loopback + hashed storage chosen); no contested alternative remains.
